description: POST /chat returns trace_id, answer, related_files, and tool_calls.
acceptance_criteria: stable top-level response fields
unique trace_id
notes: Covered by tests/test_chat_api.py.

description: Read-only repository file tools list, read, and search allowed text files inside repo_path.
acceptance_criteria: path traversal rejected
sensitive and binary files skipped
no local absolute path leak
notes: Covered by tests/test_file_tools.py.

description: CodeAgent uses ToolExecutor through a minimal deterministic AgentLoop.
acceptance_criteria: tool_calls contain safe summaries
related_files are repo-relative
no automatic code modification
notes: Covered by tests/test_agent_harness_kernel.py and tests/test_chat_api.py.

description: Skill metadata loader discovers .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md metadata without reading full skill bodies.
acceptance_criteria: returns name, description, and relative path
does not execute skills
does not affect /chat routing
notes: Covered by tests/test_skill_loader.py.

description: Skill content loader reads selected SKILL.md bodies with path and size boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: only .agents/skills paths allowed
rejects traversal and symlink bypass
does not execute skills
notes: Covered by tests/test_skill_loader.py.

description: Agent Harness Kernel introduces RequestRouter, ToolRegistry, AgentLoop, and TraceEvent.
acceptance_criteria: deterministic routing
internal trace events
no future runtime components exposed
notes: Covered by tests/test_agent_harness_kernel.py.

description: Tool calls pass through PermissionPolicy and ApprovalGate before execution.
acceptance_criteria: allow/deny/ask decisions
unsafe tools blocked
approval-required tools do not run without valid context
notes: Covered by tests/test_agent_harness_kernel.py and tests/test_chat_api.py.

description: Deterministic query understanding and repo-local lexical RAG.
acceptance_criteria: SearchPlan created
citations use repo-relative paths
no vector DB or LLM rewrite
notes: Covered by query understanding, repo RAG, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Local deterministic embedding retrieval and hybrid fusion while keeping lexical retrieval first-class.
acceptance_criteria: no external embedding service
stable fusion
path/symbol anchors preserved
notes: Covered by repo RAG and AgentLoop tests.

description: Evidence Pack and deterministic character context budget summarize repo evidence internally.
acceptance_criteria: evidence pack stays internal
budget summary recorded
no /chat schema change
notes: Covered by tests/test_evidence_pack.py and related AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Grounded answer generator consumes included evidence and optional model provider boundary.
acceptance_criteria: default fake provider
citation validation
provider audit does not leak prompt/output/API key
notes: Covered by model provider, grounded answer, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Bounded deterministic query rewrite and deterministic rerank before Evidence Pack.
acceptance_criteria: max 3 variants
rewrite/rerank audit internal only
no real LLM rewrite/rerank
notes: Covered by query rewrite, rerank, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Repo-local SQLite PREF/LTM, process-local STM, explicit memory commands, and internal memory audit.
acceptance_criteria: user/session/repo scoping
explicit commands precede repo search
no vector memory or auto summary
notes: Covered by tests/test_memory.py and AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Repo-local Long Task control plane with pause/resume, scratch summaries, and ReAct trace skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: no /tasks API
resume advances at most one step
no real subagents or worktree automation
notes: Covered by tests/test_long_task.py and AgentLoop/API tests.

description: Read-only Assistant Control Surface returns current capabilities, Memory counts, Long Task summary, and next commands through /chat.answer.
acceptance_criteria: no repo RAG for status
no memory/task DB creation
no public API/schema change
notes: V19 later allows audit.sqlite3 creation for all /chat requests while preserving no memory/task DB creation.

description: Safe Patch Authoring creates pending patch proposals from repo evidence and applies only after explicit confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: pending patch scoped by user+repo
patch_apply requires valid context
no tests/commit/worktree automation
notes: Covered by patch authoring, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Verification Runner executes fixed whitelisted pytest, ruff, or verify labels through ToolExecutor and the current isolated Python interpreter.
acceptance_criteria: rejects arbitrary shell and extra args
fails closed before tool spawn when pytest or Ruff is unavailable
uses controlled pytest environment and canonical Python verification entry
redacted truncated output
no persisted verification result in V17
notes: Runtime behavior is covered by verification runner, canonical entry, AgentLoop, and chat API tests; the reviewed repository pytest, Ruff, and canonical verification baseline is green.

description: Patch + Verify Loop chains explicit pending patch apply and whitelisted verification in one confirmed flow.
acceptance_criteria: combined confirmation requires patch id and verification label
no verify on apply failure
no automatic repair/worktree/commit
notes: Covered by patch authoring, verification runner, AgentLoop, and chat API tests.

description: Persistent Audit / Recovery records redacted audit summaries for all /chat requests and key patch, verification, and long task events, then serves read-only recovery through /chat.answer.
acceptance_criteria: repo-local .repopilot/audit.sqlite3 scoped by user_id + repo_key
no full diff/stdout/stderr/Evidence Pack/provider content/secrets/DB path/local absolute paths persisted
missing audit DB recovery query does not create state
audit write failure does not break primary /chat
recovery/status does not call repo_rag or mutate state
no new public API or /chat top-level fields; no automatic retention/pruning
notes: Covered by tests/test_persistent_audit.py, AgentLoop/API tests, full verify, and V19 Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Confirmed patch flows create a controlled detached and locked Git worktree, then apply and optionally verify inside its internal execution path.
acceptance_criteria: standalone patch and combined Patch + Verify leave the main working tree unchanged
worktree_create requires valid confirmation context and clean non-bare Git repository preconditions
execution_repo_path remains internal and local absolute paths are not exposed or persisted
patch success transitions to applied_in_worktree and worktree lifecycle is persisted by user_id + repo_key
read-only worktree status queries do not call repo_rag or mutate repository files
no automatic worktree cleanup, commit, merge, push, promote, retry, or continuation
notes: Covered by tests/test_worktree_isolation.py, AgentLoop/API/audit tests, real Git worktree integration, and V20 validation evidence.

description: Read-only scoped worktree inventory and inspection with consistency checks and bounded redacted preview.
acceptance_criteria: inventory and inspection are isolated by user_id + repo_key and never create or modify state
preview paths come only from machine-readable fixed Git output; untracked files are count-only
preview rejects unsafe/binary content and enforces 20 files, 6000 total chars, 80 lines per file, and 300 chars per line
inventory and inspection skip persistent audit while retaining safe request-local trace
no re-verification, cleanup, reconciliation, promotion, main-workspace write, commit, merge, or push
no new public API or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented in ca8e299 and archived at openspec/changes/archive/2026-06-09-v21-worktree-inventory-inspection/; covered by targeted regression, full verify, OpenSpec validation, and Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Explicit fail-closed re-verification of an existing scoped retained worktree using the existing verification whitelist and harness boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: only exact worktree re-verification commands with pytest, ruff, or verify are accepted
scope, directory, Git registry/path, and HEAD/base consistency are checked before execution
only patch_applied, verification_failed, or verification_succeeded worktree lifecycle states are eligible
verification runs only inside the retained worktree and the main workspace remains unchanged
executed results use verification_succeeded or verification_failed while patch remains applied_in_worktree
every recognized attempt produces a distinguishable redacted persistent audit result
no cleanup, reconciliation, promotion, patch mutation, arbitrary shell, new API, or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented in 30ae5a6 and archived at openspec/changes/archive/2026-06-14-v22-worktree-re-verification/; covered by targeted tests, adjacent regressions, full verify, OpenSpec validation, internal/external review, and Stage Debt Sweep evidence.

description: Explicit confirmed disposal and narrow fail-closed reconciliation of scoped retained worktrees.
acceptance_criteria: only exact confirmed discard and reconcile commands execute; discussion and malformed attempts do not fall through
scope, expected path, Git registry/path/lock, linked-worktree ownership, and HEAD/base are checked before destructive action
normal disposal and allowed reconciliation follow strict ordered idempotent lifecycle transitions
shared Git metadata reads enforce independent timeout and a hard output bound before content is read
patch closeout uses true no-create lookup and patch_id + user_id + repo_key scoped status update
every recognized attempt produces a redacted scoped persistent audit result
no promotion, patch mutation/reapply, implicit repair, automatic retry, prune, arbitrary shell, new API, or /chat top-level fields
notes: Implemented in 3991d4a and archived at openspec/changes/archive/2026-06-15-v23-worktree-disposal-reconciliation/. Merge-after formal review findings were fixed on feature/v23-review-remediation; formal re-review found no new P0/P1/P2 and full verification passed.

description: Explicit confirmed promotion of a verified retained patch worktree into the main workspace through the existing patch_apply Harness boundary.
acceptance_criteria: only exact confirmed promotion commands are routed after disposal/reconciliation and before re-verification
scope, lifecycle, clean main workspace, base HEAD, Git/worktree metadata, patch hash, and stored-patch content integrity are checked before writing
main workspace writes use stored controlled patch data through ToolExecutor, PermissionPolicy, ApprovalGate, and patch_apply without copying worktree files
successful promotion marks both patch and worktree promoted; persistence failures roll back the main workspace and lifecycle state
recognized attempts produce a scoped redacted audit event and preserve the existing /chat response schema
no commit, merge, push, branch/PR automation, background task, connector, notification, worktree deletion, prune, automatic retry, or automatic repair
notes: Covered by tests/test_verified_patch_promotion.py, adjacent patch/worktree/audit/AgentLoop/API regressions, OpenSpec validation, full verify, implementation review triage, and archive evidence for add-verified-patch-promotion.

description: Repo-key scoped mutation lock serializes RepoPilot-owned write-risk patch, verification, worktree, disposal, and promotion flows.
acceptance_criteria: same-repo concurrent mutation attempts fail closed before repository mutation
write-risk ToolInvocationContext values require lock provenance before PermissionPolicy and ApprovalGate approval
ordinary patch apply, combined Patch + Verify, standalone verification, retained worktree re-verification, disposal/reconciliation, and verified promotion are covered
read-only inventory, inspection, audit recovery, capability status, memory/task status, and repo search remain unlocked
lock conflict, unavailable storage, stale ownership, owner mismatch, and release failure use safe redacted answer/audit semantics
no /chat top-level fields, scheduler, queue, background retry, automatic repair, commit/merge/push, branch/PR automation, connector, notification, direct worktree copy, or git worktree prune
notes: Covered by tests/test_repo_mutation_locking.py, adjacent patch/worktree/promotion/verification/AgentLoop/API regressions, OpenSpec validation, and full scripts/verify.ps1 evidence for harden-repo-mutation-locking.

description: Local repopilot CLI thinly maps demo commands to existing ChatService and AgentLoop behavior with a demo-ready capability surface.
acceptance_criteria: ask, patch, patch confirm, patch confirm --verify, verify, status, and audit latest map to existing chat messages
patch requests map to create patch: <request> without relying on user wording
global --repo, --user-id, and --session-id defaults and overrides are supported
output is sectioned from public trace_id, answer, related_files, and tool_calls only
verification labels are limited to verify, pytest, and ruff
patch ids must match ^patch_[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,122}$ and unsafe ids are rejected before ChatService
unsafe verification input is rejected before ChatService
no new /chat fields, network dependency, default CI change, provider wiring, arbitrary subprocess, or Verified Patch Promotion
notes: Covered by tests/test_cli.py; implemented as a local console script entrypoint app.cli:main. V24 is CLI presentation/command mapping only; Verified Patch Promotion was intentionally excluded from V24 and implemented later in V25.
